title: Show active file in run status header
summary: Prioritize the backend-confirmed active filename in the global run-status header and remove its redundant supporting-telemetry row.
reason: Operators need the file currently being processed to be the most prominent status text, with run mode, queue scope, and lifecycle state as quieter context.
behavior_before: The topbar headline showed Run Once, Backend Queue, and Running while the active filename was available only in Current Work; a third line displayed supporting telemetry.
behavior_after: For a current backend-queue worker, the topbar headline shows the verified active filename and the grey metadata line shows Run Once, Backend Queue, and Running. Multiple active files use a compact additional-file count. The supporting-telemetry row is no longer rendered.
tests_added: Updated the browser run-monitor smoke to assert the active filename hierarchy, compact run metadata, and removal of the telemetry row.
manual_validation: Bundled Node.js syntax check and direct runtime assertions for single-worker and multi-worker active-file headlines - passed.
Bundled Python unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_home_live_state_smoke - passed (1 browser-backed test).

Bundled Python unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_run_monitor_smoke - blocked before the changed header assertion by the unrelated in-progress run-monitor module split: launch acceptance was not connected to Current Work.

rollback_plan: Restore the prior topbar monitor summary ordering and re-add the telemetry markup and styles; revert the matching browser assertion.
